questions.prompt: Who can fit through the small door near the roots?
questions.evidenceText:
He found a small door near the roots.
It was very small.
Too small for most of them.
"I can go," said Fern.

questions.prompt: Why has Twig been unable to find her spectacles?
choices: They were on top of Twig's head.
They were under her collected things.
questions.answer: They were on top of Twig's head.
questions.evidenceText: The spectacles were on top of Twig's head.

questions.prompt: What does Twig's visit through the larger door show about a good home?
choices: It can include private space and time with friends.
Twig preferred the large room to her own small room.
The new door made Twig leave her old room behind.
questions.answer: It can include private space and time with friends.
questions.rationale: Twig is happy living in her own room, then enjoys visiting the big room but says she likes her room better; this shows a good home can include private space and time with friends.
questions.evidenceText:
She sat in the big room and looked around.
"I like it here," she said.
"But I like my room better."

supportingEvidence.evidenceText:
"I live here."
"I have always lived here."
She seemed perfectly happy about this.
